candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, causing the gateway checkout route to fail with 502 responses within tens of milliseconds.
candidates.uncertainty: Which internal order dependency (postgresql, payment, inventory) produces the 500 is not established; order logs were excluded.

report.explanation: Checkout returns 502 in 16-110ms while traces show the gateway's POST /v1/orders call to order failing with 500 Internal Server Error. Fast failures indicate the order service errors immediately rather than timing out. Gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout. Root cause is bounded to order-service 500s; the specific internal fault is not yet established.
